subject: Request to move PoC demo to post-budget sync
messages:
From: Sophie Lam <sophie.lam@planex.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Shaw <oliver.shaw@planex.com>
Date: 2027-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PoC demo timing — internal capex review next week

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the invitation to the PoC. Quick heads-up from our side: we have a finance-driven capex review and a temporary spend hold that runs through the first week of September while the CFO reconfirms the FY allocation. That review is the gating factor for any pilot commitments.

Given the timing, would you be open to either:
- pushing the full PoC demo until after our planning sync on Tue Sep 7 (preferred), or
- running a short 20–30 minute exec summary next week so stakeholders get visibility without committing to a pilot yet?

If we do the short summary, Oliver and I can make a 30-min window on Fri Sep 3 between 9–11am PT. Otherwise we'll confirm availability after Sep 7. I've attached a short intake spreadsheet with the items procurement will want ahead of any commit.

Apologies for the shuffle — wanted to flag early so you can plan.

Best,
Sophie Lam
Head of Product Partnerships | PlanEx
Att: PlanEx-Requested-Info.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lam <sophie.lam@planex.com>
Cc: Oliver Shaw <oliver.shaw@planex.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-30T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PoC demo timing — internal capex review next week

Hi Sophie — thanks for the heads-up and for sending the intake file. Totally understood on the capex gating.

Two options that work for us:
1) Short executive summary (20–30 min) next week so you can show momentum to the CFO group — we can demo value props, high-level architecture, and a light pricing sketch.
2) Postpone the full PoC demo until after your planning sync (week of Sep 13) and use next week to prepare the pre-read and updated quote.

I attached a 3-up agenda for the exec summary and a preliminary quote so you can share with procurement if helpful. Please let us know which you prefer and we'll lock it.

Next steps: confirm exec summary slot or confirm preferred week after Sep 7 and we'll send calendar invites.

Thanks,
Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

On Mon, Aug 30, 2027 at 9:12 AM Sophie Lam <sophie.lam@planex.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the invitation to the PoC. Quick heads-up from our side...

Steph — short note from our side: we prefer to avoid a full commitment until the capex decision is final (CFO travel + budget reforecast). That said, an exec summary will be useful. Fri Sep 3 at 10:00 AM PT works for Sophie and me.

Can you send a 20-min slot (10:00–10:20) and a 1-page pre-read we can drop into the planning packet?

Thanks — Oliver
Oliver Shaw
Director, Strategic Initiatives | PlanEx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Shaw <oliver.shaw@planex.com>, Sophie Lam <sophie.lam@planex.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-30T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PoC demo timing — internal capex review next week

Hi all — adding a quick technical note. We can absolutely do a 20-min exec summary that focuses on three things: 1) architecture + data flow, 2) predictable latency/cost levers (batching/quant profiles), 3) security/compliance highlights for procurement.

For the full PoC (when approved) we'll want a short intake with target prompts, expected QPS, and a small sample dataset for performance tuning. If Sophie/Oliver can share the procurement checklist from the attached intake, Monica and I will tailor the pre-read to address procurement questions directly.

I've attached the draft quote for reference.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Att: Quote-PlanEx-Redwood-2027.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-08-31T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PoC demo timing — internal capex review next week

Thanks everyone — confirm plan below so we have the same expectations:

• Exec summary: Fri Sep 3, 2027, 10:00–10:20 AM PT — 20-min live call (Rishi will run the demo highlights; I'll lead the procurement/next-steps section).
• Pre-read: 1-page summary + procurement-focused appendix to be shared by EOD Thu Sep 2 (we'll post to the Drive folder linked below).
• Full PoC demo: tentatively scheduled for week of Sep 13, pending your capex sign-off. Once you confirm budget, we'll lock a detailed multi-hour slot and circulate a mutual action plan.

Action items:
- Sophie/Oliver: confirm approval for the Sep 3 10:00 slot (reply here is fine).
- PlanEx: share completed intake/procurement checklist from your attachment so Monica can tailor the appendix.
- Redwood: we'll send calendar invites and the pre-read link (Drive) by Thu EOD.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PoCfolder
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/contacts/123456

Appreciate the flexibility — we want to make this as low-friction as possible while respecting your internal timing.

Best,
